title: Model aliases resolve to the intended model
summary:
Model aliases resolve correctly, Enter explains itself a little better, and Hacktoberfest ideas have room to grow.

The shared registry now resolves configured aliases to their service IDs. Enter uses the resolved model for free-usage checks and generation prices, rather than treating an alias as the default text or image model.

The dashboard gained a collapsible FAQ covering Pollen, access and model pricing. Updated branding, typography and card layouts make balances and API keys easier to scan; balances now show two decimal places.

PrisimIG joined the creative-projects list. The Hacktoberfest ideas guide was added and then reshaped around contributor-submitted, buildable app specifications, with starter examples and guidance for submitting multiple ideas. The bot and game concepts are prompts to build, not finished integrations.

daily.title: Model aliases resolve correctly
daily.text: Configured model aliases now resolve to their intended models, including when Enter checks free usage and calculates generation prices. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).
